atlasPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: PRODUCTION 2D sprite animation atlas for the Counting Sheep app, not a mockup.
Input 1 is Ollie's canonical original neutral sprite. Input 2 is the founder-approved ears-back pose. Input 3 is the founder-approved tongue greeting. Preserve these exact character design invariants: brown-and-white border collie, purple circular eyes, brown nose, white blaze/chest/front paws and white tail tip, softly textured paper-cut illustration. Do not redesign the approved ears or tongue.
Create ONE atlas of 12 full-body keyframes in an exact 4-column by 3-row grid, 1536x1024 canvas, no dividers, no lettering, no numbers. EVERY CELL has the same camera scale, same proportions and same ground baseline near its bottom. Character centered within each cell, entire body, no overlap into adjacent cell. Keep generous small clear gaps. The standing/sitting dog is about 280 pixels tall; lying dog is naturally shorter at the SAME physical scale, not enlarged to fill cell.
Frames left to right, top to bottom:
1 canonical seated neutral upright ears, closed mouth.
2 seated ears halfway rotating toward the APPROVED folded-back shape.
3 seated exact approved photo-based low folded-back ears, closed mouth.
4 seated original upright ears with exact approved small pink tongue greeting.
5 ears folded back, forelegs start sliding forward and chest leans down, hindquarters still seated.
6 soft controlled flop: forelegs extend, chest almost at floor, head upright with folded-back ears.
7 lying on belly, hindquarters settled, front paws extended, head raised, mouth closed.
8 same lying pose, head settles closer to paws, relaxed open purple eyes.
9 same lying pose with chin resting on paws, eyes softly shut. This will hold for three seconds.
10 lying pose, head lifts, eyes open, folded-back ears.
11 pushing chest up using forelegs, hindquarters beneath body, beginning return to sit.
12 canonical seated neutral exactly matching frame 1, original upright ears.
MUST deliver a PNG with actual TRANSPARENT ALPHA outside the dogs, not a painted checkerboard, not black/green/white solid background, no shadow rectangle. No accessories or ornaments. All dogs match the canonical proportions, no giant heads, extra limbs, cut-off ears, sideways wings or almost earless head. Preserve the approved folded ear geometry. This atlas will be rendered over a Farm background; painted background pixels are not acceptable.
extractionPrompt: Edit target: the supplied 12-pose Ollie sprite sheet. BACKGROUND EXTRACTION ONLY. Deliver an actual RGBA PNG with fully transparent alpha=0 outside the twelve dogs. Remove the entire painted white/gray checkerboard including gaps between limbs. Do not paint a new checkerboard or a solid background. Keep every dog's original pixels, pose, size, location, colour, face, ears, paws and texture unchanged. Keep canvas 1536x1024 and exactly the same 4x3 arrangement. No new shadows, outlines, decorations or text. This must be usable directly as transparent game sprites over any colour.

resolution.method: local Apple Vision foreground masks keyed by source-crop hash; no source upload or generative redraw
